relations.subject: Govind Chandra Pande
relations.evidence: He started his professional career as a lecturer in Allahabad University in 1947.

relations.subject: Govind Chandra Pande
relations.role: Reader in the Department of Ancient History, Culture and Archaeology
relations.evidence: He was Reader in the Department of Ancient History, Culture and Archaeology till 1957 and was promoted as Dean, Faculty of Arts.

relations.subject: Govind Chandra Pande
relations.role: Tagore Professor of History and Indian Culture
relations.evidence: He joined the Department of History and culture at University of Rajasthan as the Tagore Professor of History and Indian Culture in 1962.

relations.subject: Govind Chandra Pande
relations.evidence: He served as the Vice-Chancellor of University of Rajasthan from 1974-1977.

relations.subject: Govind Chandra Pande
relations.evidence: Pande rejoined the Allahabad University in 1978 after a gap of 20 years. Being senior most Professor he became officiating Vice Chancellor of Allahabad University for few months.He retired  in 1984.

relations.subject: Govind Chandra Pande
relations.evidence: During 1984-88 he was Visiting Gaekwad Professor at BHU.

relations.subject: Govind Chandra Pande
relations.object: Indian Institute of Advanced Study, Simla
relations.evidence: He was also the chairman of the Indian Institute of Advanced Study, Simla for several years
